I'm sorry but this game is horrible! You don't even earn lives over a period of time. Unless you spend money, you have to log in every hour to collect 2K coins which isn't even enough to start a level! Once you advance a little bit, it costs more to start a level than the measly amount of coins you collect. Forget if you need extra cards. The premise is great, but it's just another pay to win game. Do better Disney!

Great game, solid game play, but it's basically 100% pay to win. Once you're out of coins (which are easy to accidentally spend) you only get one refill (ie ONE PLAY) per hour. Who has the patience for that? And if you don't pass a level you can't reset it to try again, you have to replay it and that costs coins so you just have to wait an hour to do a re-deal. What a money grab.
